slices.title: Draft, publish, restore and per-version bundles
slices.summary: Session-core migration 0097_agent_skill_drafts adds draft/draft_updated_at/draft_by to agent_skills; capability-core PATCH writes a draft when SKILL_DRAFT_PUBLISH is on, with POST publish and POST versions/{v}/restore (restore writes a draft, publishing cuts the new version). capability-core migration 0034_skill_bundle_retention replaces the one-bundle-per-skill unique index with a state column (live/draft/superseded), Put supersedes instead of deleting, and GC keeps blobs named by any version. capabilities.proto GetSkillBundleManifestRequest gets manifest_sha256=2, and skill_file/skill mounts read the pinned version's bundle. Behind SKILL_DRAFT_PUBLISH and SKILL_BUNDLE_RETENTION.
slices.remaining: Waits on D2 and D10 acceptance (through S2). SKILL_BUNDLE_RETENTION must not be turned on until D2-379/D2-383 (bundle read authz) are fixed. [Decisions taken 2026-11-04 at the recommended option (owner).]

slices.title: MCP App host in the frame: JSON-RPC over postMessage
slices.summary: New pure mcp-app-bridge.ts on top of widget-bridge.ts checks: answers ui/initialize with host info and theme, sends tool-input and tool-result notifications once, handles ui/size, ui/open-link (safe link), ui/message (staged chip), answers tools/call with an app_call_requires_chat JSON-RPC error until S10, every other method method-not-found (method names in one table, verified against the extension at slice start). New McpAppFrame.tsx fetches the resource via chat-client getMcpAppResource, labels 'App fra <server>', shows the network notice, uses sandboxWidgetDocument with the shim, never caches. ChatMessages.tsx draws at most 2 apps per answer under settled mcp__ tool calls, chat surface only. Action contracts chat.open_mcp_app and chat.stage_mcp_app_message. Switch VITE_MCP_APPS (default off; needs S1 and S3 switches).

slices.title: session-core api_key principal and api origin stamp
slices.summary: Behind SESSION_CORE_API_KEY_PRINCIPAL, validate_identity accepts an api_key token with the gateway's exact shape rules (sub apikey:<key_id>, acting_user_id, no user_id/service_id, no waiver) as PrincipalKind::ApiKey, and the interceptor admits it only on a closed method list (thread create/append, run start/get/list/cancel/terminal, conversation read); every other RPC is permission_denied. Its runs are stamped origin api with api_key_id and api_key_owner attribution. Off: the token is unauthenticated exactly as today.
